notes.title: A1.0 Update
notes.content:
1.Hard mode open (An elite monster attack every 7 stage, a chance to strengthen yourself every 10 stage, and a BOSS every 20 stage.)
2.New BOSS: God Yvette
3.Added 22 enchantments to weapons
4.Added 20 blessings to Goddess Statue
5.New mechanic: Temporary Shield, which neutralizes damage before health, is represented by a yellow health bar. The value of temporary shields decreases over time
6.Yvette's second talent can be used
7.Alysa was born with one blessing: Cut Slash

4.Bambi Story mode is open

notes.title: T6 Updates Explain
notes.content:
Next, the production of T6 content will be carried out, including:  
1. Yvette is introduced  
2. Novice guidance (tutorial)  
3. Main Story Chapter 1, Chapter 2, Chapter 3, Chapter 4 and Final Chapter

notes.title: T5 Update 7.0
notes.content:
1.Runes - Collection: Runes can be found in the level, a total of 5 runes in each adventure, scattered in random level locations, as long as the touch can activate and collect runes.
2.Runes - Record: Once you collect 5 runes in a single adventure, you will see a rune string in the settlement screen, regardless of whether the player is alive or dead. Be sure to record the pattern and sequence of the runes at this time. Once you leave the settlement screen, you will never see the rune string again.
3.Rune-rewards: Rune strings are used to unlock a wide variety of rewards in rune workshops, including divine gold, enhanced materials, and exclusive weapon enchant.
4.Exclusive weapon enchant can be unlocked through runes and obtained. The unlocked exclusive weapon enchant can be assembled in the 'Exclusive Weapon' window of the 'Space Temple'.
5. Exclusive Weapon - Emendator longsword, added new function: Dash moves to add slash, slash deals damage and bounces off all ranged attacks
6. Exclusive weapon - Devilian, added new function: Sprint action to teleport
7. Exclusive weapon - Fire Dragon, added new function: Charge action can leave mines in place
8. Fixed an issue where an ice tornado would kill the Goblin merchant in the Snowfield scenario

notes.title: T5 Update 6.0
notes.content:
1.Disintegrating a normal weapon will result in 1-18 weapon fragment based on its quality
2.Exclusive weapons are fully loaded and can be summoned by accumulating weapon fragments (hold down R to summon). Exclusive weapons have unique normal attack and charge attack, but exclusive weapons cannot be "normal enchanted".
*Emendator longsword: Normal attack: light - light - light - Heavy. Charge attack: Flame Slash(Fast multi-section fire slash, plus long-range flying blade attack)
*Devilian:Normal attack: Dark Laser. Charge attack: Necromancer Field(A large area blast deals magic damage and has a 6% chance of instant death, and summons several spirits for an auto-tracking attack)
*Fire Dragon:Normal attack: Mass Fire. Charge attack: Fire dragon Bullets(Fire dragon bullet projectiles, causing massive damage and igniting enemies)
*Blood Edge:Normal attack: light - light - light. Charge attack: Swivel Blade (During this time, the 'dash' movement was changed to 'blade jump' - (Teleport to the swivel dagger position and launch an area attack) )
3.Added a new window to the Temple of Space - Exclusive Weapon: You can change the exclusive enchant match of exclusive weapon here
4.Goblin merchants can be killed to loot goods, but there are serious consequences
5.Exclusive enchant for exclusive weapons will be introduced in the next update

notes.title: T5 Update 4.0
notes.content:
1.Fixed an issue where mana could not be restored to maximum and stone giants could not land when falling from the sky
2.Increased wait time for BOSS attacks
3.[Blinded]  and [confused] status are now installed
-Blinding: player's field of vision will now be severely limited. Enemies appear to lose the player's location information
-Confused: the player's direction control will now be inverted. The enemy will move aimlessly
4.Terrain interaction optimization
-Red berries: a red glowing berry bush that restores 12 health when eaten
-Evening primrose: flowers of bright blue that restore 20 mana when consumed
-Venomous mushroom: a purple, shiny mushroom that explodes poison when attacked
-Tindergrass: Flammable grass endemic to the desert. When hit by an attack, it causes a fire that burns any creature
-Sponge mushroom: Explodes when attacked, creating an underfoot quicksand zone that pulls anything to the center
-Ice mushroom: Explodes when attacked, causing an area to freeze
-Ice tornado: In snow, lingering too long in the same scene will start to appear, causing slow down and a probability of freezing
-Cigar stalagmite: Periodically squirts fire into the surrounding area, causing a burning effect and sputtering lava if attacked
-Shrivelled mushroom: When attacked, it produces purple smoke, causing chaos in its area
-Magma floor: It ignites when you step on it and periodically erupts lava
5.Added a new low probability event - Dark Torch: Lighting a dark torch will result in an elite enemy encounter, and killing all elite enemies will reward you with three chests.(There must be a treasure chest.)

notes.title: T5 Update 1.0
notes.content:
1.Fixed an issue with being able to move after entering a portal.
2.Weapon system major changes - Combo attacks: Melee weapons now have a combo attack instead of a single slash attack. Most weapons now have a combo of light and heavy hits. Heavy hits do more damage and are able to ignore golden shield enemies and cause stiffer effects, but heavy hits have more backswing.Note that the dagger is a high-combo weapon with no heavy hits.
3.Weapon system major changes - Reload: Ranged weapons, with the exception of the bow, need to reload before each shot and move slightly slower during reload. (Similar to melee weapons, the bow does not need to be loaded. The crossbow can fire three arrows in a row at the end of a single reload, The musket uses a single reload)
4.Weapon system major changes - Spell: Magic weapons also charge to cast spells, and the flight speed of spells has been reduced, but all spells have been changed to area damage.
5.Weapon system major changes - Charge attack: The right button of all types of weapons is changed to charge attack, charge attack is divided into three phase, each increase of a phase can make charge attack damage increase and change the form, charge will continue to consume mana, especially magic weapons.
6.Battle system major changes - Hit Recover: When an enemy is hit by a melee weapon, it generates a hit Recover, which interrupts the enemy's attack motion, and a heavy hit gives an additional strong knock back effect. Hit recovery lasts 0.5 seconds with a light hit, while hit recovery lasts 1.5 seconds or more with a heavy hit, during which the enemy cannot move or attack.Note that ranged and magic weapons cannot cause enemies to hit recovery.
7.Monster major changes - Golden shield: An enemy with a shield and some larger enemies will now display a gold shield. An enemy with a gold shield will not have hit recovery when heavy attacked, but the gold shield will shatter when hit hard and take longer to repair.
8.Monster major changes - Spell shield: Blue spell shields appear on some enemies, which are highly resistant to magic attacks.
9.Monster major changes - Boss: Currently, bosses are not affected by the Hit recovery, but high frequency of heavy hits can cause the boss to accumulate fatigue, and when fatigue is full, the boss will fall for 3 seconds.
10.Adjusted the range and mode of attack of all monsters, reduced spawns of monsters, increased Hit action and Hit recovery action of all monsters.
11.Some types of weapons (double axe, Battle axe and Hammer) have been temporarily removed to coincide with the launch of the new weapon system.
12.Fixed an issue that caused portal anomalies when sapling monsters grew into tree monsters.
13.Fixed talent effects for characters.
14.Next up will be a rework of the weapon charge attack and new weapon enhancement gameplay.

notes.title: T4 new update plan description
notes.content:
*At present, according feedback, after many times of thinking, I decided to redesign the characters and weapon system, which is a lot of work, so it will take a lot of time. I hope you can understand. For players who have not bought the game, please be careful whether to buy it or not.
*The T4 updates, may appear extreme strong character or extreme weak character, because I was tested on Maneuverability feedback, hope you can understand, The current character will change when the T5 solution is completed, but I'd like to hear more from you via email about whether the current operational feedback is appropriate. mail: 470507624@qq.com
*T5 Character scheme Objective: To simplify the character, removing the character's dependence on a specific weapon class while retaining a characteristic talent skill.
*T5 Weapon program objectives: The existing rarity and level attribute differences will be eliminated, and the new weapon system will put more emphasis on personalized weapons and enrich the attack modes of weapons.Specifically: the left mouse button changed to tap and heavy hit of the combo, the right mouse button changed to the storage force release weapons of special skills, the keyboard space bar is changed to use weapons of the sprint attack action.(The specific key position can be changed after the "Custom Key Setting" is installed)

notes.title: T4 Update 1.0
notes.content:
*All character talents have been reworked
*Swordsman with a longsword and a giant sword, pressing [Shift] to sprint will now cast the ability: [Blood Break] (Slashing while charge, and beat back all enemies)
*Witch with a magic weapon, pressing [Shift] to sprint will now cast the ability: [Teleportation] (Enter transfer state.Transfer state time slows down, after selecting the target position that you want to transfer, click the left mouse button to transfer)
*Hunter with a bow and a crossbow, pressing [Shift] to sprint will now cast the ability: [Split Arrow] (Sprints can shoot arrows.)
*Vampire with a dagger and a spear, pressing [Shift] to sprint will now cast the ability: [Dark Walker] (Make a quick stealth sprint that must trigger [Lord of the blood] at the end of the sprint)
*Can dodge melee and ranged attacks during sprint, but will still be affected by abnormality
*Tornado skill increased, movement speed and duration increased
